headline: Kellogg Reformulates Rice Krispies and Coco Pops Due to Rice Shortages
summary: Kellogg has removed rice from Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, substituting it with rice flour and rice blends due to changing weather conditions impacting grain availability.
why: Climate-driven agricultural supply disruptions force major food manufacturers to alter input formulations, affecting supply chain costs and product margins.
